create_theil_sen_regressor: create a Theil-Sen regressor model for robust multivariate linear regression with outlier resistance
fit_theil_sen_regressor: fit a Theil-Sen regressor model on training data X and target vector y to learn coefficients and intercept
compute_spatial_median: compute the spatial median (L1 median) of a set of points using iterative Weiszfeld steps
calculate_breakdown_point: calculate the breakdown point approximation for a Theil-Sen estimator given sample and subsample counts
compute_lstsq_weights: compute least squares weights on subsamples of design matrix X and target y using LAPACK gelss
